title: Soono le numih fayya
intro: Kaxxaam madqimte rooci, uxih gibdi gibbatul gibbateeh, qaadik ane sinni safar qemmise. Tama numtin amoh giti aysinuuy, baxsi kee qadli sinni gandittel asta luk sugeeh, dubuk mango masquuliyyat kee kaxxa agle luk suge. Atu ta assakat le muuci Kur'aanak baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu inki adda aysineh suge too yol xayi marat, miraacisam adda xer baxsi yi xaleyna kee buxa.
Anu kaxxa gibdaabinitteh uddur yot garaye, safar marah dago mellebit xaamaanam edde anuk.
Anu qadli sinnim qellat abeemih malkimeh sugeeh, liggiditte casbit tatruse, takkay immay yi imaan aggiriqqe kal raaqeh.
anu baxsale dudda yomcowwe afeytissuh centibbaaru le mablooli, too silac sumaaqiteh yok curriyyat gitat.
yi wale kee numma ellecaboh yoo miraacisseh kaxxa reedantuh arac kee aamanti iro baaxol.
ittallakleh tekkookat, anu inni idaltuh yan xaleyna kee tooboko lih der uddur kee qansari raaqek lakal qagitak ongoorowe.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَـٰجِدِينَ
verse: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me." (12:4)
